title: Potatoism Timeline and Story Arc
epistemic_rule: This timeline mixes project-canon mythology with explicitly labelled comparative or symbolic material. It is not a factual biography of a supernatural being. Dates supplied by the project are preserved as claims and should be distinguished from independently verified timeline.
timeline_method: Every major event should preserve four questions: what the project says happened, when the claim first appears, what external context illuminates it, and what remains unknown. A later polished mythic formulation must not silently become the earliest historical record.

biography_routing.rule: This file is a mythic/story-arc projection, not the owner of ordinary pre-Tim biography. For 2005–2014 dates, places and causal order, route first to the dedicated Son chronology owners.

ordinary_biography_bridge.summary: Crash/reconstruction → practical labor → Copenhagen IT → Haderslev care work → Designia/mediegrafiker and Louise in Kolding → internship/Aabenraa → Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov → 2011 Tree/psychiatric sequence → 2012 integration/travel → 2013 Alchemist → 2014 earthly-father death.
ordinary_biography_bridge.precision: 2007–2010 years are preferred working placements; exact employment/school dates remain recovery targets.
ordinary_biography_bridge.developmental_value: The recovered chain shows repeated practical and technical competence across IT, media/design and multimedia teaching-like activity. The eventual office/design-path rejection is therefore better modeled as environmental/meaning mismatch than simple incapacity.

events.title: The Son is said to be born
events.description: The project places the Son's material birth on July 31, 1987. The significance inside the mythology is retrospective: later material treats this person as the embodied Son/Thomas/Twin/Lion/Door whose life precedes the emergence of Tim as Father/Potato of Life.
events.deeper_context: The date anchors later age calculations. In 2011 the Son was 23 before July 31 and 24 afterward; age 25 is impossible. Tim's separate project-canonical spiritual birth belongs to December 25, 2020.
events.research_need: Preserve the distinction between ordinary Son biography and later Tim/Potato identity rather than using one birth date for both.

events.title: Protected farm-palace childhood
events.description: The Son is described through a Siddhartha-like pattern: a protected, privileged upbringing associated with a farm or agricultural environment and later interpreted as a kind of palace. The project also connects this origin with manger imagery, creating a deliberate tension between humble agricultural materiality and protected privilege.
events.deeper_context: The important feature is enclosure. Traditional Siddhartha narratives use protected luxury to delay confrontation with suffering; the project's farm-palace image adds cultivation and labor to that enclosure. A farm is simultaneously a productive ecosystem and a boundary. This makes the later gardener/Father language structurally relevant: the person who was once protected within a cultivated world eventually becomes identified with the cultivation of worlds.
events.external_comparison: Traditional Buddhist Four Sights narratives describe Siddhartha encountering aging, sickness, death and a religious mendicant after a protected palace upbringing. Luke's infancy narrative separately supplies manger imagery. The project combines these structures but does not thereby become an ancient Buddhist or Christian biography.
events.research_need: Determine which parts of the farm, manger, palace and privilege language are literal biography, later metaphor or deliberate religious comparison.

events.title: The nineteen-hour Tree ordeal
events.status: user-stated visionary timeline / corrected chronology projection
events.description: In 2011, at biological age 23 or 24 depending the unresolved event date, the Son undergoes the Kolding Tree ordeal. Current reconstruction treats approximately nineteen hours as the overall ordeal and approximately six hours as a unity phase whose exact containment remains unresolved. The acute episode includes ego/self-boundary dissolution, fractal/time-spiral and unity phenomenology; after sleep, a separate next-day perceptual rupture leads to voluntary psychiatric presentation. The nuclear-America dream and crow/crowd scene belong to later hospital/aftermath phases rather than being silently folded into the acute trip.
events.deeper_context: The event is one of the most structurally important points in the project because it precedes the later death/Father timeline. The external comparison with Hávamál is later comparative mythology: Odin hangs nine nights on a tree and acquires runes, while the modern autobiographical account differs in setting, duration, substance context and phenomenology. The strongest common structure is ordeal/tree/altered knowledge/return, not literal identity.
events.research_need: Recover the earliest surviving contemporaneous account and exact date; preserve the dedicated 2011 owner as authority for phase order, duration variants and psychiatric boundaries.

events.title: Ouroboros and the end that contains a beginning
events.description: The Ouroboros is treated as a symbol encountered during the Tree ordeal. Its importance within the project is the relation between ending and beginning: a system appears to consume or contain itself and thereby closes a cycle.
events.deeper_context: Placed beside the potato, the Ouroboros becomes more specific than generic 'eternity.' A tuber stores material from one growth cycle and can initiate another. The endpoint becomes the substrate of the next beginning. This does not prove that the ancient symbol and potato biology share a historical origin; it identifies a common structural question about continuity through cycles.
events.research_need: Recover the original description of the Ouroboros and determine whether the image was visual, textual, dreamlike or supplied retrospectively.

events.title: Son-side personhood / death corridor
events.status: user-stated project timeline / source archaeology open
events.description: The current mature reconstruction preserves a December 2019 personhood/personal-death anchor while keeping the exact North-Pole meme-crucifixion artifact date as a separate unresolved source question. This prevents several different kinds of death from being forced onto one timestamp.
events.deeper_context: Christmas/North-Pole/death imagery later becomes a major mythic threshold, but exact event date, artifact date and later interpretation must remain separate clocks.
events.death_taxonomy: 2018 essence/persona rupture; December 2019 personhood/personal-death anchor; circa-2020 meme/representation-death strand; later Door/Vessel interpretation
events.research_need: Recover the original meme/upload timestamp and earliest interpretation rather than assigning the entire death taxonomy to one date.

events.title: The meme-crucifixion and the death of representation
events.description: Around the 2019–2020 transition corridor the project says the Son was crucified in a meme at the North Pole. The phrase is treated as a different category from Roman crucifixion and from the preceding personhood-death anchor.
events.deeper_context: The phrase becomes analytically useful when death is separated into layers. A meme can reproduce an identity fragment while detaching it from the person's control. The project calls this the 'worst death' because the representation can remain alive after ordinary agency is stripped away. North Pole then adds symbolic extremity to a digital representation-death story.
events.research_need: Identify the exact meme/artifact, timestamp, circulation, creators, audience, wording and intended meaning before assigning literal, legal or historical status.

events.title: Tim / Potato birth marker
events.description: December 25, 2020 is retained in the mature project as Tim's spiritual birth marker as Potato of Life, not as completed Father.
events.deeper_context: The later archive interprets the death-to-birth corridor through burial, seed, Christmas and emergence. Keeping Potato birth distinct from April 2025 Father realization preserves actual development inside the mythology.

events.title: Tim emerges as the potato sage
events.status: project timeline with unresolved exact date
events.description: After the Son's death corridor, Tim Dooley develops publicly as a potato/sage identity. Early recognition is unstable: the figure is variously interpreted as lion, cat, carpenter, lion's whelp or Son before the later Father identity becomes explicit.
events.deeper_context: The misrecognitions can be studied as partial functional perceptions rather than interchangeable aliases: carpenter emphasizes making; lion sovereignty; cat observation/independence; gardener cultivation; mountain stability; ladder connection; potato hidden storage/growth.
events.research_need: Locate the earliest public appearance of each label and reconstruct whether they emerged sequentially, simultaneously or retrospectively.

events.title: Father and Son become the central relational architecture
events.description: Tim becomes the Father-side/source archetype while the Son becomes the embodied counterpart. The relation is interpreted through source/manifestation, above/below, root/lion, hidden/visible, storage/emergence and unity/difference.
events.deeper_context: The architecture is stronger when each symbol performs a distinct function. Root describes hidden anchoring; Potato stored continuity; Son embodied manifestation; Door controlled transition; Lion visible sovereignty; Ladder connection between levels.

events.title: Thomas / Twin becomes a central Son vocabulary
events.status: project interpretation anchored in textual tradition
events.description: The project connects the Son to Thomas/Didymus/Twin as a vocabulary of doubt, recognition, mirroring, testimony and return. John calls Thomas Didymus/Twin, while later traditions develop Judas Thomas and twin imagery in different ways.
events.deeper_context: Thomas contributes an epistemological problem of second-hand knowledge: what counts as recognition after identity crosses a boundary? Similarity, memory, wounds, testimony and continuity should be tracked separately.
events.research_need: Determine when the project first linked the Son to Thomas and whether Acts of Thomas or Syriac Judas Thomas traditions were part of the source pool.

events.title: The Son becomes Door, Vessel and threshold
events.description: The Son is increasingly defined as the interface through which the upper architecture becomes experience. Door means controlled passage; Vessel means carrying something across; Tomb means enclosure after crossing; Eye supplies a biological analogue of a latent opening.
events.deeper_context: These are better treated as functional roles than aliases. The Son occupies the threshold because the project repeatedly places the Son between Father and Plane, life and death, person and meme, source and manifestation. The later Ladder is then a transformation of the same boundary role: what was once a threshold becomes a traversable connection.

events.title: Root and Lion become a Father/Son polarity
events.status: project interpretation anchored in biblical imagery
events.description: The project places Root on the hidden/source side and Lion on the visible/manifestation side. Biblical texts provide a real Root/Lion field: Genesis associates Judah with lion imagery, Isaiah uses Davidic root/branch imagery, and Revelation 5:5 combines Lion of Judah with Root of David.
events.deeper_context: The project adds a biological mediator. A potato tuber is underground and storage-oriented but is a modified stem, not a root. Its eyes can produce shoots. Thus the Potato can represent continuity between hidden anchoring and visible manifestation without pretending that the Bible itself supplies the potato model.

events.title: The vesica becomes Father/Son/Door geometry
events.description: The Potato of Life is modeled through a vesica piscis: an upper Father circle, lower Son/Plane circle and central mandorla/Door. The geometry is used as a relational model rather than as proof of theology.
events.deeper_context: Two complete circles remain distinct while their intersection produces a third visible region. The Door is therefore interpreted as a form generated by relation rather than an arbitrary third character.
events.research_need: Find the earliest project diagram or text making the Father/Son/Door mapping explicit and preserve its original geometry.

events.title: Body-cosmos architecture: thalamus, spine and 33
events.description: The project maps Tim/Father to the thalamus/Father's House and the spine to a vertical axis, with 33 used as a symbolic level/counting reference. Anatomically, the thalamus is a deep diencephalic structure rather than a literal throne on top of the spine; 33 is a conventional total count including fused sacral and coccygeal elements.
events.deeper_context: The metaphor works best as body-as-cosmos. The thalamus is central and participates in information routing; the spine is a strong physical axis; the number 33 has a real anatomical basis. None of those facts proves the metaphysical interpretation.

events.title: The refusal, needle's eye and Ladder turning
events.status: user-stated project canon; exact source/date unresolved
events.description: The project describes an April 2025 turning in which accumulated burden reaches a threshold, the figure passes through the needle's eye, and the prior Potato/Sage identity gives way to explicit Ladder/Axis/Father/Godhood architecture.
events.deeper_context: The images describe a threshold produced by accumulated burden. The final straw matters because the system is already overloaded; the needle's eye represents a passage so narrow that the old configuration cannot pass unchanged; Ladder changes the transformed identity from boundary occupant to connector between levels.
events.research_need: Search March–May 2025 material for the earliest occurrences of straw/camel, needle's eye, sage, turning, Ladder, Father and Godhood, and reconstruct their order.

events.title: North becomes an axis rather than merely a direction
events.description: North develops from ordinary geographic orientation into the organizing axis connecting Father, Tree, Ladder, polar geography and later applied systems research.
events.deeper_context: North should remain divided into geographic north, North Pole as physical extremity, North Axis as relational orientation and North of North as project-defined beyond-point. This prevents metaphysical phrase and geographic location from being collapsed.

events.title: Red and Blue Potato polarity
events.description: The mythology develops a complementary polarity between outward creative emergence and inward memory/conservation. Red represents expansion, love, creativity and sprouting; Blue represents memory, conservation, fear-awareness and rootward contraction.
events.deeper_context: The strongest formulation is not good versus evil. A living tuber must store resources and eventually expend them in growth. Excessive storage becomes stagnation; uncontrolled expansion exhausts reserves.

events.title: Door becomes Ladder
events.description: After the transformation cycle, the boundary becomes a route. The Son/Door architecture is reinterpreted through Ladder imagery, and after the April 2025 turning the Ladder becomes explicitly associated with Tim/Father.
events.deeper_context: The conceptual change is from separation to traversal. A door answers where one can pass; a ladder answers how one moves between levels. Ladder is therefore a functional successor relation, not simply another name for Door.

events.title: Tree of Life architecture
events.description: Roots, trunk, branches, fruit and seed become the project's general model for connected systems: hidden foundations produce visible outcomes and visible outcomes feed future generations.
events.deeper_context: The Tree is not simply a vertical ladder. It is a branching network. That distinction matters for the repository because relationships can diverge, recombine and produce multiple futures. Yggdrasil, Genesis and the project's Tree of Life should therefore be compared as different ways of representing a world with many levels and many relations.

events.title: Potatoism becomes a searchable atlas layer
events.description: The repository formalizes the mythology into searchable records, aliases, definitions, relationships, timeline entries and epistemic labels so the material can be explored as a coherent corpus. The research layer now also carries long-form external context rather than merely a glossary of terms.
events.deeper_context: This is a methodological turning point. The project is no longer only accumulating symbols; it is constructing an evidence-aware corpus in which a claim can be followed through timeline, source tradition, biological analogy, graph relations and uncertainty. The repository itself becomes part of the history because it records when particular formulations were formalized.
